title: Per-layer quantization anchors and cosine-drift sentinel for embedding profiles
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Define and implement a per-layer hybrid INT8/FP16 quantization profile with stable scale anchors, a calibration workflow using mixed synthetic + customer-like corpora, and a cosine-similarity drift sentinel that drives rollouts and alerts. This ticket covers: (1) quant profile schema changes to support per-layer anchors and per-channel scale locks, (2) offline calibration harness and acceptance metrics, (3) realtime drift sentinel logic and thresholds, and (4) Console/Dashboards + automated rollback hooks.
acceptance_criteria: New quant profile schema stored in model metadata with per-layer anchor scales (schema backwards-compatible)
Calibration job that produces reproducible per-layer anchors for INT8 and FP16 fallback and artifacts committed to our model registry
Evaluation harness produces a report with mean cosine similarity, 50/90/99th percentile drops, and false-positive rate for sentinel across 3 corpora
Drift sentinel implements per-corpus thresholds and generates alerts in Console with an actionable runbook link
Automatic canary rollout stops and reverts if sentinel breach > configured tolerance (default: >2% of queries beyond 99th percentile drop)
Documentation & Confluence doc outlining when to rerun calibration and how to interpret sentinel signals
work_log: 2025-02-11: Kickoff w/ Applied ML + Runtime teams. Agreed on hybrid strategy: prefer INT8 on transformer blocks 3..10, keep FP16 on input & last projection layers to reduce representational loss.

2025-02-18: Prototype offline calibrator implemented (python). Per-layer symmetric/asymmetric scale experiments run on small corpus (news+wiki mix). Initial mean cosine drop ~0.6% vs fp32 baseline; worst-case tail (99th) = 3.1%.
2025-02-24: Design review with Console team — sentinel alerts should support per-corpus grouping and allow suppressed alerts for retraining windows.
2025-02-28: Bench results on A100 (quantized runtime) show throughput +28% and median latency -12% for INT8 path with hybrid profile; documented microbench PR: github.com/redwood-inference/pr/1247.
2025-03-03: Validation run on customer-sim corpora (support/tickets synthetic) shows false-positive sentinel rate 0.9% at current thresholds; need to tune to <=0.5% before wide rollout.

2025-03-05: Incorporated feedback to add per-seed consistency check and store calibration RNG seed in model metadata for reproducibility. Next: implement production sentinel consumer and dashboard queries.
notes: Calibration workflow should produce both an authoritative anchor set and a light-weight delta patch for quick retrains.
Sentinel decision: compute per-query cosine to the fp32 baseline embedding if baseline stored, otherwise use rolling reference window of recent accepted queries.
Edge-case: short inputs (< 8 tokens) amplify quant noise — plan to clamp thresholds or force FP16 path for those queries.
Ops runbook: link to automatic recalibration job scaffold and Slack alert channel #quant-sentinel-alerts.
Follow-up tickets: integrate quant profile exporter to model packaging, and create PM dashboard for customer-facing incidents.
